scenes.narration: Why does Walmart, with 713 billion dollars in revenue, need to sell ads?
Because it keeps only about 4 cents of every dollar as operating income.
About 280 million people visit each week. Brands pay to be seen by them.
In fiscal 2026, Walmart's ad business grew 46 percent to nearly 6.4 billion dollars.
Memberships and other income added about 6.8 billion more.
